description_text: Ledges State Park is famous for its 100-foot sandstone ledges, scenic driving canyon, stream crossings, and wooded hiking trails.
campground_text: Offers 82 electric/standard sites and 12 hike-in primitive sites. Modern restrooms, hot showers, dump station, and playground.

description_text: Maquoketa Caves State Park features more caves than any other state park, offering hiking trails through gorges and underground limestone passages.
campground_text: Lakeside pine forest campground with 28 sites total (18 electric sites, 10 non-electric/hike-in), restrooms, showers, and dump station.

description_text: Gull Point State Park lies on the shores of West Okoboji Lake, offering boating, swimming, fishing, hiking, and historic stone structures.
campground_text: Features 112 campsites total (60 with electricity), modern bathhouse with showers, dump station, and playground in a heavily wooded area.

park_name: Mines of Spain State Recreation Area
description_text: Mines of Spain State Recreation Area features rugged limestone bluffs overlooking the Mississippi River, historic lead mining sites, and the Julien Dubuque Monument.
